title: Sharing Fairly and Halves
seo_title: Grade R Sharing and Halves Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Use and name unitary fractions in familiar contexts (a half); solve practical problems that involve sharing equally.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: sharing fairly, fair or not fair, and halves of shapes and small groups. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Sharing fairly means everyone gets the same.
  • Give one each, again and again, until none are left.
  • A half is one of two equal parts.
  • Half of 6 is 3: share 6 between 2.

Examples

Example

Share 8 sweets between 2 friends

one each, again and again

Answer: 4 each

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Unequal sharesEveryone gets the same.
Unequal halvesHalves must be the same size.
Counting sharesCount the objects in one share.
